title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Numbers 11: the fire at Taberah, the complaint about manna, the seventy elders, Eldad and Medad, and the quails at Kibroth Hattaavah.

questions.text: Why was the place called Taberah?
questions.explanation: When the people complained, Yahweh's fire burned among them, so the place was called Taberah.

answers.text: Because the people found water there
Because Yahweh's fire burned among them
Because the people buried their dead there

questions.text: Which of these foods did the people say they remembered eating in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The people remembered the fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic they ate in Egypt.
The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

questions.text: How many men of the elders of Israel did Yahweh tell Moses to gather?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to gather seventy men of the elders of Israel and bring them to the Tent of Meeting.

questions.text: For how long did Yahweh say the people would eat meat?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they would eat meat not just one, two, five, ten or twenty days, but a whole month, until it came out at their nostrils.

questions.text: How many men on foot did Moses say were among the people?
questions.explanation: Moses said the people among whom he was were six hundred thousand men on foot.

questions.text: Which two men prophesied in the camp instead of going out to the Tent?
questions.explanation: Eldad and Medad remained in the camp; the Spirit rested on them and they prophesied in the camp.

questions.text: Who said, "My lord Moses, forbid them!"?
questions.explanation: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, answered, "My lord Moses, forbid them!"

answers.text: A young man from the camp

questions.text: What did the wind from Yahweh bring from the sea?
questions.explanation: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall around the camp.

questions.text: Why was the place called Kibroth Hattaavah?
questions.explanation: The place was called Kibroth Hattaavah because there they buried the people who lusted.

answers.text: Because the quails fell all around the camp there
Because Moses prayed to Yahweh there
Because the seventy elders prophesied there
Because they buried the people who lusted there
